newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt pound strengthens against dollar.
newsitem.headline: Egypt pound strengthens against dollar.

text.p: The Egyptian pound strengthened against the dollar on Sunday in a private sector market with plentiful U.S. dollar supply, bankers said.
"There are lots of dollars. Maybe they are funds coming from institutional investors," said one banker.
The market had been dollar-short for several weeks before the end of the government's financial year on June 30.
Three actively trading banks quoted the dollar at between 3.3860 and 3.3875 bid and 3.3885 and 3.3900 offered in the interbank market.
The average rate on Sunday was 3.38666 pounds bid and 3.3895 offered in the interbank market, versus 3.38875 bid and 3.390625 offered on Thursday.
The Central Bank calculated the average exchange rate at midday as 3.386420 pounds buy and 3.395997 pounds sell..
